$comment: The source of truth for display-mode recipes, version 1. Version 1 stays open for changes until Release 2’s public release, then freezes. After that, optional additions with sensible defaults keep version 1; anything that would break an existing recipe (renaming or removing a field, changing a value’s meaning, renaming a slot) goes to version 2, with an automatic migration on load and a test for it. Slot ids are permanent once released. (Owner, 2026-11-17; docs/decisions.md 338.)
